prompts.bg: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single ultra-wide 3:1 continuous painted game background panorama for BitDog level 2 TREETOP ORCHARD. Reference is style only: warm lush detailed storybook game painting with clear layered depth. An enchanted apple orchard in late summer golden light: left distant red farm cottage and barn, center rows of apple trees with red fruit and distant little treehouses, right a sunlit hillside orchard with a timber windmill. Playful slightly oversized twisting orchard trees. Blue sky with soft cream clouds in upper third. Keep middle-upper play band uncluttered enough to see raised platforms later. The bottom quarter is a calm continuous grassy orchard floor with some scattered amber leaves, no large foreground obstacles. No platforms, crates, pickups, dog, people, signs, lettering or UI. Absolutely ONE continuous landscape with no panels, no divisions, no vignettes. Wide side-scrolling horizontal composition, level horizon across full width. We will losslessly cut overlapping tiles from this one master so all internal joins must be continuous. Rich but slightly subdued environment colors so golden dog and dark-edged interactive props read clearly.
prompts.props: Use case: illustration-story. Game prop sprite atlas for BitDog Treetop Orchard, reference establishes painterly style only. Exactly SIX separate props on transparent alpha background in a strict 3-column 2-row grid. Large transparent gaps, all props contained within their cells, no text or borders. Top row left: small red wooden orchard shed with a flat sturdy cream-edged roof suitable for a dog to stand on, simple 3/4 side view, full building. Top middle: long thick horizontal springy tree branch with sparse apple leaves near its tips, broad flat mossy top surface and sturdy wood silhouette, isolated unattached branch. Top right: low rectangular golden hay bale tied with two red-brown cords, clearly an obstacle. Bottom left: wide soft mound of amber and red fallen apple leaves, low profile shallow oval. Bottom middle: squat wooden crate filled with red apples, chunky dark edges, clearly an obstacle. Bottom right: smaller complete gnarled apple tree with red fruit, dark brown trunk, full canopy with generous margins. Warm afternoon light from upper left, rich storybook game art matching reference. All interactive props must have crisp dark silhouette outlines, pale top edge highlights and readable forms at small size. No dog, people, coins, signs or extra props. Genuinely transparent background.
prompts.pov: Use case: illustration-story. A first-person forward view down a winding grassy path through the exact enchanted apple orchard in the reference panorama. Same late-summer apple trees, red apples, distant red farm sheds, small treehouses and hillside windmill, same blue sky and cream clouds, same warm painted game-art style. This is the owner's viewpoint after throwing a coin down the level. Wide 16:9 landscape camera at adult chest height. Foreground path begins bottom center and recedes to a clear open patch of SKY slightly right of center at horizon. Apple trees frame both sides and form receding rows. Clear readable central vanishing point, beautiful rich foliage, gentle sunny atmosphere. No dog, no person, no hands, no Bitcoin, no text, no effects, no UI. Exact theme continuity with reference, new forward perspective rather than sideways panorama.

Preserve the owner's exact torso, hand holding Bitcoin, slate trousers and cream shoes; his head and neck stay ENTIRELY above the top picture edge. Keep exact locked framing and wide 2:1 composition with whole dog central-right. Replace the park behind them with the sunny apple orchard shown in image 2: apple trees heavy with red apples, distant little red orchard barns, treehouses nestled in trees, blue sky, mountains, very distant windmill. Warm grass-edged dirt path under the characters. No new characters, no text. Polished painted animated-film art, clean anatomy and edges. This is the first frame of a smooth throw animation.
